title: Product of Array Except Self
description: Build an output where each position is the product of all input values except the value at that position, without division. Implement `solve(data)` in Python. The input is a JSON-compatible map; return only the requested result and do not mutate caller-owned collections unless the task explicitly says in place.

examples.explanation: Applying the stated rules to this independently authored case produces the shown result.

constraints: Inputs use only the fields shown in the examples and deterministic tests.
Collections contain at most 10,000 items; text contains at most 20,000 Unicode code points.
The result must be deterministic for identical input.
